hook.narration: Mount Testa is the highest mountain in Fictland.

claims.text: Mount Testa is the highest mountain in Fictland.
claims.source_quote: Mount Testa is the highest mountain in Fictland, with a summit elevation of 6,412 m (21,037 ft) above sea level.
